Imagine Black Friday... forever. Ninety percent off everything. Every single day. It never ends.
A TV for nine dollars? I'll take ten!
Week two. You buy a gaming chair for two dollars. Then nine more, for your friends. You don't have nine friends.
Week three. Mom fights a grandma for the last toaster. The grandma wins.
Month two. Every shelf is empty. Stores lose money on every sale, so they close. Then the factories close.
Mom, can we buy a toaster?
One year later, you eat cold bread, in front of forty-seven TVs.
